verdict.rationale: Auth0's own log streaming service exports tenant logs in near real-time with configurable content type and payload format, which gives an event stream of tenant activity. The evidence only describes exporting to a 'log analysis service'. It never confirms registrable HTTP webhook endpoints for programmatic consumers, or that specific sign-up, sign-in and user-change events are delivered for sync purposes. Actions are a developer building block for customizing flows, not an event subscription, so they earn no credit. Missing for 10: documented outbound HTTP webhook/custom-endpoint destinations, explicit coverage of sign-up/sign-in/user-change event types, delivery guarantees or retries, independent corroboration.
